name: emw-remove-duplicates
label: EMwrap Remove Duplicates
help: Remove the duplicate coordinates (or particles) of a set, using the distances of an *emw-coordinates-compare* job that compared the set to itself. Of the coordinates within the distance of each other, the one with the highest score is kept (rlnLCCmax, rlnAutopickFigureOfMerit, rlnScore, rlnConfidence or rlnMaxValueProbDistribution, the first one in the set), or the last one without a score, as Relion's 'remove duplicates'. The output is the subset of the set without the duplicates (optimisation_set.star, particles.star and tomograms.star). It can also be launched from the 'Coordinates Distances' view of the compare job in EMhub ('Remove duplicates').

params.name: input_distances
params.label: Distances:
params.help: distances.npz of an emw-coordinates-compare job with 'Compare to itself' (e.g. External/job012/distances.npz). Its input set is the one the duplicates are removed from.

params.name: distance
params.label: Distance (A):
params.help: Coordinates closer than this distance (Angstrom) are duplicates. Empty: the maximum distance of the compare job (all the distances are stored, so any distance can be used).
